data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Jasda', meaning 'knowledge' or 'wisdom'. In Christian tradition, Jadda represents God's divine knowledge and understanding. The name Jadda carries the meaning “God's Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jadda usually hope their child will grow to embody god's knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
